name: Automated Response Technology Program
description: Earn rewards for enrolling smart devices (thermostats, EV chargers, heat pump water heaters, batteries) that automatically shift energy use during peak demand; incentives set by each provider
fullDescription: PG&E's Automated Response Technology Program rewards customers for enrolling smart home devices that can automatically adjust energy use during peak demand periods, helping stabilize the grid.
whatTheyOffer:
- Rewards paid by your enrollment provider (amounts vary by provider)
- Eligible devices: smart thermostats, EV chargers, heat pump water heaters, battery storage
- Automatic adjustments during peak times
- Helps reduce energy costs
- Supports grid reliability
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a PG&E customer
2. Own a compatible internet-connected smart device
3. Enroll through a participating provider listed on PG&E's program page (such as SmartFlex Rewards by Uplight or Deco Energy; PG&E enrolls some batteries directly)
4. Allow device to auto-adjust during demand events
5. Receive rewards from your provider
keywords: smart thermostat, Nest, ecobee, Tesla, PG&E, demand response, energy savings, smart home, EV charger, battery
